name: Dynamic Custom Cursor
description: Replaces the system cursor with a pill badge that follows the mouse smoothly and changes its label based on the card being hovered, flipping sides near the viewport edges.
contents: Row of link cards, each with a small label, title and its own cursor text
Floating pill cursor badge showing the current text
Two blurred glow blobs behind the cards
behavior: System cursor is hidden inside the component
Badge follows the mouse with eased quickTo tweens and pops in with a small scale on card enter
Badge text switches to the data-cursor value of the hovered card and resets on leave
Badge flips to the other side of the pointer near the right and bottom viewport edges
Cards lift and show a gradient glow on hover
editableByProps: Number of cards, their labels, titles, links and per-card cursor text
Default cursor text and badge offset from the pointer
Background, badge, card, border, glow and label colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the glow blob colors or positions
needsCodeEdit.where: The two absolute blur-[120px] divs at the top of the root
The quickTo calls xTo and yTo

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the pop animation on card enter

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Hides the system cursor inside the component, so it is a mouse-only effect and shows no badge on touch devices
Adds a window mousemove listener while mounted and removes it on unmount
Badge position tracks window coordinates and flips against the window size
